name: Kaioken Serve
summary: Kaioken Serve is a static site generator and server for wiki-style documentation repositories. It reads markdown docs, cards, skills, and a graph of document relationships from disk, renders them into HTML pages, and serves them over HTTP with a local development server. The module is organized into graph building, library loading, markdown rendering, page templates, and HTTP serving layers.
keyPoints: Reads a library from markdown docs, card files, skill files, and a plan, indexing them by path and source with freshness tracking (current/stale/orphaned/unknown).
Builds a graph with three node kinds (doc, file, section) and three edge kinds (contains, links, source) from the library index.
Serves wiki pages, card pages, skill pages, a graph view, and a search view, with a shared layout providing sidebar navigation, per-document outline, and a local graph rail.
HTTP server supports wiki, card, skill, and symbol kinds with path confinement, pagination, and artifact state caching with async refresh.
Markdown rendering includes table support, safe URL filtering, heading outline extraction, and query term highlighting, with full CSS theming for light/dark modes.

entryPoints.name: buildGraph
entryPoints.note: Builds a Graph from a root directory and Library, creating doc/file/section nodes and contains/links/source edges.

entryPoints.name: readLibrary
entryPoints.note: Reads and assembles a Library from markdown docs, cards, skills, and plan files under a root directory.

entryPoints.name: serve
entryPoints.note: Starts an HTTP server serving the wiki, cards, skills, and search pages using the built library and graph.

entryPoints.name: renderMarkdown
entryPoints.note: Renders markdown source to HTML with table, inline, heading, and safe-URL handling.

entryPoints.name: wikiPage
entryPoints.note: Renders the wiki overview page listing documents grouped by chapter, with special handling for templates.
